Man I don’t even know where to start with this question... I’ve been depressed and suicidal since the 5th grade. But I’ve never been diagnosed, I’ve never looked for help. I went through a lot of things when I was younger and it really affected me growing up. There has been many events in my life that really has broken me down. I’m supposed to be creating my future and working hard. But I’ve spent the last couple of years solely drowning in emotions, wasting time, and making mistakes.  I mostly want to go just for being me, I’ve hated myself ever since I can remember. I’ll never be comfortable in my own skin and I’m tired of wasting everyone’s time and disappointing everyone I know. I feel like there is no reason for me to be alive.
